ActivityEntryDto.description: One row of the activity feed, as served on the wire.

idempotency_key.description: Caller-chosen key that makes a retried comment safe: a repeat returns the thread with the first comment only.

ApplyPlan.description:
Items refer to each other by their local `name`; a reference that is no name in the plan is an existing item's key
or external reference. The whole plan is validated before anything is written, and applying the same plan (`id`)
again creates nothing: every write is keyed `plan:<id>:<name>`. Unknown fields are refused, so a typo is an error,
not a silently dropped field.

id.description: Names this plan: the same id and names are the same items on a second apply.

BlockedStoryDto.description: A todo story that cannot start because of a decision.

CheckResult.description: The outcome of the last record check on a required decision.

oneOf.description: The record's own `reversibility` (kb/ADR-0013 R2); absent from older checkers and records without it.

kind.description: `decided`: the reason says what was decided; `withdrawn`: why it is no longer needed (kb/ADR-0013 R3).

CloseSprint.description: Closes the active sprint; every goal needs a verdict.

oneOf.description: Decided or withdrawn (kb/ADR-0013 R3); absent on closes made before it.
The kind of token that closed it; absent on closes made before kb/ADR-0013.

ClosureKind.description: What a close says (kb/ADR-0013 R3): the decision was made, or it is no longer needed.

oneOf.description: Set when the comment is on an epic; absent from servers before it.
Set when the comment is on an initiative; absent from servers before it.

external_ref.description:
The item's origin elsewhere, e.g. the Jira key it was migrated from (`JPD-30`). It names one item across all
three types, and a later import of the same reference finds this item instead of creating another.

CreateGoal.description: Adds a goal to the draft, or to the active sprint with `active`. The owner defaults to the caller.

CreateInitiative.description: Every create request carries a caller-supplied idempotency key; a repeat returns the same item.

external_ref.description:
The item's origin elsewhere, e.g. the Jira key it was migrated from (`JPD-30`). It names one item across all
three types, and a later import of the same reference finds this item instead of creating another.

The item's origin elsewhere, e.g. the Jira key it was migrated from (`JPD-30`). It names one item across all
three types, and a later import of the same reference finds this item instead of creating another.

owner.description: The story's owner (email); it must be an allowed user.

CreatedGoalDto.description: `POST /goals`: the goal and its sprint's warnings after the add.

entries.description:
In page order: groups in `QueueGroup` declaration order, then server order within each group. Clients must not
re-sort.

blocks.description: The todo stories whose readiness fails on this decision; empty outside the blocking group.

DecisionQueueSummaryDto.description: Counts over open, unsatisfied decisions only; `blocked_stories` counts each story once.

DemoStoryDto.description: A story completed in the window's last seven days (never before its start), oldest first.

DoneFilter.description:
Which done stories `GET /stories` lists: every one (the default), or only those that entered done within the
instance's `[board] done_window_days`. Stories in other states are always listed.

EditDecision.description:
Edits a required decision's planner-side fields (kb/ADR-0004 R2). The record reference is set with `link`, the check
result by the checker; neither is accepted here, and any field not listed is refused rather than ignored.

decider.description: `null` leaves the decider unchanged, like absent (as in `EditItem`).

due.description: Some(None) clears the due date; None leaves it alone.

oneOf.description: Some(None) clears the classification; None leaves it alone.

title.description: `null` leaves the title unchanged, like absent (as in `EditItem`).

EditGoal.description: Each field is optional; an absent one is left as it is.

oneOf.description: Some(None) clears the epic; None leaves it alone.

external_ref.description:
Records the item's origin elsewhere once (the Jira key a hand-made item was migrated from), under the same rules
as on create; the reference it already has again is no change, and an existing one is never changed or cleared.

oneOf.description: An epic's parent: Some(None) clears the initiative; None leaves it alone.
A story's kind (story, bug, chore); None leaves it alone.

owner.description: Some(None) clears the owner; None leaves it alone.

target_month.description: Some(None) clears the target month; None leaves it alone.

Empty.description: The value of a response that carries nothing; serialises as `{}` and has a real schema component.

ExportDto.description:
The whole instance as one consistent snapshot (`GET /api/v1/export`): every list is read inside one
`REPEATABLE READ` transaction. Items order by key number, decisions, comments and activity by id, users by email.
Users carry emails and roles only; the export never holds token hashes, secrets or configuration.

sprints.description:
Every sprint, oldest first, with its goals (confidence, verdict) and their links nested. Not in the DTOs:
`created_at` of sprints and goals and who linked what and when. The exported activity carries the goal's
`created` entry and each item's `goal_linked` entry (actor, time); a draft sprint's creation is not logged.

Finding.description:
Something worth a look on an initiative or an epic. Advisory: computed on read, never stored, and never consulted by
a move (kb/ADR-0003 keeps one gate, readiness). Shown by the CLI, the web and quoted by the planning skills.

oneOf.description: The brief is empty.

The brief cites Jira or Confluence, or says something was decided, and no required decision is on the item or
above it: a cited page or a "decided" is not a record anyone can check once the source is gone.
Discovery is marked complete while a required decision on the item is open and not satisfied.
Discovery is marked complete and nothing has been broken down under the item yet.

GoalContextDto.description: A goal the story serves, for story context: the goal, its sprint's dates and through which item.

links.description: The items linked to this goal, in key-number order; an epic or initiative link covers their stories.

oneOf.description: A draft from an agent or automation, waiting for a person to record or discard it (kb/ADR-0014 R5).

GoalProgressDto.description: One goal's counts over a sprint's window (kb/ADR-0014 R2).

blocked_decisions.description:
Live: recomputed on every read from the decisions open now, even for a closed sprint. For a closed sprint, show
the value at close instead, from the `counts` in the sprint's `closed` activity entry; this one is today's.

GoalRefDto.description: One active-sprint goal a story serves, and through which item (the nearest link wins).

GoalVia.description: Through which item a story serves a goal.

ImportComment.description: A Jira comment, kept with its original author and date.

ImportInitiative.description:
A Jira initiative imported in its current state. `external_ref` is the Jira key and the idempotency
key: importing the same reference again creates nothing.

discovery_complete.description: Marks discovery complete, by the importing actor at import time.

ImportStory.description: A story created directly in its delivery state: no gate is consulted and no override is logged.

oneOf.description: Required exactly when `delivery` is done.

Imported.description:
`created` is false when the external reference already existed (create-only, re-runnable). Items carry `key`,
comments carry `id`.

progress.description: completed / not-dropped; None when nothing counts yet

InstanceConfigDto.description: What the client needs from instance configuration (kb/ADR-0009 R2): never hardcoded in the client.

done_window_days.description: `[board] done_window_days`: how far back `done=recent` reaches. Absent from servers before this field existed (deserialises as 0, meaning unknown).

import_enabled.description: `[import] enabled`: the import endpoints answer 404 unless this is true.

IssuedTokenDto.description: The secret is shown once; the server stores only its hash.

LinkGoal.description: Items to link, each a key or external reference of any level.

OpenSprint.description: Opens the draft; the end defaults to one `[sprints] length_days` after today.

PlanApplied.description:
What the plan came to: every item and decision by its local name, with `created` false when an earlier apply of
this plan had made it, and every blocker edge with `created` false when it was already there.

PlanBlock.description: `blocked_by` blocks `story`; each is a plan story's name or an existing story's key.

on.description: A plan item's name, or an existing item's key.

oneOf.description: One-way or two-way; absent leaves it unset (kb/ADR-0013 R1).

initiative.description: A plan initiative's name, or an existing initiative's key.

oneOf.description:
The state of the migrated ticket: todo when absent. Any state needs `external_ref`; one other than
todo is created in that state and logged `imported`, as the importer does, never `override`. Done is the
importer's alone (it needs a resolution).

epic.description: A plan epic's name, or an existing epic's key.

oneOf.description: story when absent.

PrStatus.description: A pull request's state as GitHub last reported it; a cache, never a driver of delivery.

QueueGroup.description: Where a decision sits in the queue; the declaration order is the page order.

RankStory.description:
Places a todo story before `before` (another todo story), or at the end of the todo column when `before` is absent.
The server renumbers the column's ranks 0..n-1 in one write; only the moved story's version changes, because rank is
ordering metadata, not content an editor guards on.

Reason.description:
Why a story is blocked, or why a move was refused: a readiness fact, which an interactive override may get past, or a
delivery rule, which nothing will. `Reason::overridable` (and a refusal's `overridable`) says which.

oneOf.description: The record is in a repository the server does not check yet; it is checked once the repository is configured.
A sprint is already active; close it first.
Closing needs a verdict on every goal.
Only an interactive user may do this (kb/ADR-0014 R5).

RecordCheckResult.description: The check names the record it checked and the decision version it observed, so an out-of-order check never overwrites a relink; the server refuses a result for a reference that has since changed (kb/ADR-0004 R3).

RecordConfidence.description:
A person's confidence (`POST /goals/{id}/confidence`, interactive only) or a suggestion for one
(`POST /goals/{id}/suggestion`, any token kind).

oneOf.description: One-way or two-way; absent leaves it unset (kb/ADR-0013 R1).

on_type.description: The level of the item `on` names; one key sequence (kb/ADR-0002 R5) means the key alone does not say.

oneOf.description: One-way or two-way; unset behaves as two-way (kb/ADR-0013 R1).
